name: Find the Lost Guards
summary: Guard Thomas is waiting at Elwynn's eastern bridge for word of two missing guards. Rolf and Malakai were sent north along the river to watch for murlocs, but neither has returned.

sections.title: A Patrol Vanished
sections.body: Guard Thomas watches the eastern crossing of Elwynn Forest, where the King's road approaches Redridge. Murlocs have made the nearby waters more dangerous. Days ago, Thomas sent two Stormwind guards, Rolf and Malakai, north along the riverbanks to scout the threat and clear out nests. Neither has returned, and Thomas fears violence stopped their patrol.

sections.title: Grim Discovery
sections.body: Following the river north toward Stone Cairn Lake brings you into swarming murloc territory. At the water's edge, you find a half-eaten corpse in the mud. An engraved medallion beside the remains bears the name Footman Malakai Stone. It confirms Malakai's fate, but Rolf is still missing.

faq.q: Who gave this quest and where are they located?
aliases: who starts find the lost guards
faq.answer: Guard Thomas gave you this work. He is at the eastern border of Elwynn Forest, beside the bridge leading toward Redridge Mountains.
The missing guards are Rolf and Malakai, two Stormwind city footmen sent by Guard Thomas to scout the riverbanks and watch for aggressive murlocs.
Footman Malakai Stone's half-eaten remains lie on the river's eastern bank, just north of Guard Thomas's post and near the edge of a murloc settlement.
Local river murlocs overran Malakai and ate him. They infest the shores of eastern Elwynn Forest.
You find Malakai's remains alone by the river. Rolf is still missing, and his fate remains unknown as you track deeper into the murloc camps.

faq.q: Why were the guards sent out alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin across several territories, so small garrisons like Guard Thomas's rely on patrols of two to watch the wilderness borders.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you can see how beast and murloc attacks threaten Elwynn's outer borders, even so close to Stormwind.
As a paladin, you can honor fallen defenders by recovering their insignia and bringing justice to those guarding the kingdom's frontier.
